name: Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology
supervisors: PLA (supervising department named on China’s graduate admissions site)

evidence.summary: China’s graduate admissions site lists the Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, in Xi’an’s eastern suburbs, with the PLA as its supervising department. Its profile there describes a multidisciplinary nuclear science institute, set up in 1963, that researches nuclear radiation effects, pulsed radiation detection, electromagnetic pulse, high-power microwave, laser and pulsed-power technology, explosion physics and radiation hydrodynamics, with a pulsed reactor and large pulsed-radiation and electromagnetic-pulse simulators.
The Federation of American Scientists reports that the institute provided diagnostic support for China’s nuclear weapons test programme.
Its profile says it has carried out many research tasks assigned by the state since its founding.
